% Riemann solver template: consistency
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A7-consistency}
F_{\mathrm{num}}(\mathbf{U}, \mathbf{U}) \;=\; \mathbf{F}_x(\mathbf{U})
\end{equation}

% Rusanov (local Lax-Friedrichs)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A7-Rusanov}
F^{\mathrm{Rusanov}} \;=\; \tfrac{1}{2}(\mathbf{F}_L + \mathbf{F}_R) - \tfrac{1}{2}\alpha\,(\mathbf{U}_R - \mathbf{U}_L), \quad \alpha = \max\bigl(|u_L| + c_L,\ |u_R| + c_R\bigr)
\end{equation}

% HLLE (two-wave Harten-Lax-van Leer-Einfeldt)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A7-HLLE}
F^{\mathrm{HLLE}} \;=\; \frac{S_R \mathbf{F}_L - S_L \mathbf{F}_R + S_L S_R (\mathbf{U}_R - \mathbf{U}_L)}{S_R - S_L}
\end{equation}

% HLLC (three-wave with contact) — full definition in §A8
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A7-HLLC}
F^{\mathrm{HLLC}} \;=\; \begin{cases}\mathbf{F}_L & \text{if } 0 \le S_L, \\[2pt]\mathbf{F}_L + S_L (\mathbf{U}^{\star}_L - \mathbf{U}_L) & \text{if } S_L \le 0 \le S_{\star}, \\[2pt]\mathbf{F}_R + S_R (\mathbf{U}^{\star}_R - \mathbf{U}_R) & \text{if } S_{\star} \le 0 \le S_R, \\[2pt]\mathbf{F}_R & \text{if } S_R \le 0. \end{cases}
\end{equation}

% Roe (with Roe-averaged Jacobian A_Roe)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A7-Roe}
F^{\mathrm{Roe}} \;=\; \tfrac{1}{2}(\mathbf{F}_L + \mathbf{F}_R) - \tfrac{1}{2}\,|A_{\mathrm{Roe}}|\,(\mathbf{U}_R - \mathbf{U}_L), \quad A_{\mathrm{Roe}} \text{ from Roe 1981}
\end{equation}

% Stationary-contact flux diffusion (mass component)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A7-contact-scorecard}
\begin{aligned}F^{\mathrm{Rusanov}}_{\rho} \;-\; F^{\mathrm{exact}}_{\rho} &\;=\; -\tfrac{1}{2}\alpha\,(\rho_R - \rho_L) \\[2pt]F^{\mathrm{HLLE}}_{\rho} \;-\; F^{\mathrm{exact}}_{\rho} &\;=\; \frac{S_L S_R\,(\rho_R - \rho_L)}{S_R - S_L} \\[2pt]F^{\mathrm{HLLC}}_{\rho} \;-\; F^{\mathrm{exact}}_{\rho} &\;=\; 0 \quad\text{(exact on contact)} \\[2pt]F^{\mathrm{Roe}}_{\rho} \;-\; F^{\mathrm{exact}}_{\rho} &\;=\; 0 \quad\text{(exact on contact)}\end{aligned}
\end{equation}
